summary: The facts are clean. I ran a fresh machine check: all 233 script lines match timeline.json, and every quoted span in the narration is verbatim in quotes.json (0 mismatches). A scan of every curly-quoted string literal in the shot sources finds 0 unsourced quotations; the one hit is the AAAI-84 panel title, which is a name, not a quote. Every cited claim id exists, and every contested claim is framed as contested on screen. The VTT carries the new L1410b and L1502 wording on the 2164 s clock. I checked the round-4 rewrites against the research. L1410b ('China a year or two behind? That belief burned about two years.') matches e13-gap and e13-crash: lit Oct 2022, out Jan 2025. L1502 keeps 'nobody he met', which is faithful to q-hopfield-versailles. 'Two in the morning' matches e12-nobel-physics, and 'physicist · aged 91' is right. The round-4 removals hold on sheets rendered at 21:58-22:05Z, after every recordedAt. ch15-s06 has no Hassabis caption and no hand. ch10-s12 has no compute ratio. ch10-s10 has no 'toy weights' caption. ch15-s04 has its METR source line, and ch15-s05 letters all four labs. Two fairness regressions came in with this round's critic and credits passes, and both concern the narrator's maker. (1) ch15-s10: the end card no longer says that Anthropic, the lab that made the film's author model, is a lab in this story. The CREDITS card now reads only 'Claude Opus 5.5 · Anthropic'. The disclosure survives in credits.mjs 'detail' and on the sources page, not in the film. (2) ch14-s04b: in the three-position export-control row, a critic note moved DECISIVE · AMODEI (ANTHROPIC), KHAN (EX-NSC) to land about 5 s after the other two tags. It now lands alone in the silent tail and holds as the shot's last word. Smaller items: the script.json onScreenText still carries the three removed texts (an invitation to re-add them), and name pronunciations still have no human sign-off (fourth round).

issues.problem: The film's conflict-of-interest disclosure is gone from the picture. In rounds 2-4 the end card said the film was made by Anthropic's model, and that Anthropic is a lab in this story. The new CREDITS card (credits.json 'card' rows, 8.5-21.3 s) says only 'Research, script & code: Claude Opus 5.5 · Anthropic'. The film covers Anthropic's founding, its FTX money, its Pentagon dispute and its $1.5B settlement. A viewer of the film alone is never told that the author's maker is a party to the story. The sentence still exists, but only in generator/film/lib/credits.mjs 'detail' (player panel) and on the sources page. The user's 2026-10-13 direction was to credit more than Claude, not to drop the disclosure.
issues.fix: Put the disclosure back on the CREDITS card itself as its footer line, at the same 22 px cap italic mono. Text: 'Claude is made by Anthropic, a lab in this story, held to the same sources as every other.' Keep 'Every music cue's Strudel source: on the film's page' as a second footer line, or move it to the SOURCES card under 'claims.json · quotes.json'. Make the change in credits.mjs (card footer) so credits.json regenerates, then re-sheet ch15-s10 at +10.5 and +18.0. The layout stays as it is (credits 8.5-21.3, sources 21.3-27.9), with no clock change.

issues.problem: This is a fairness regression in the export-control row. Rounds 3-4 fixed the three positions as one row at equal size, so the film shows the dispute without ruling on it. A round-4 critic note then delayed DECISIVE · AMODEI (ANTHROPIC), KHAN (EX-NSC) to T.wordEnd('years')+0.4 (~11.5 s). HELPS HUAWEI lands at 5.59 and SELF-DEFEATING at 6.19, but the Anthropic-led position arrives 5-6 s later, alone, in the silent tail (sheet: 2 tags at +10.71, 3 at +12.67), and holds as the shot's final image. Because it arrives last and in silence, it reads as the verdict, and it is the position of the narrator's own maker.
issues.fix: Bring all three tags in together: DECISIVE at tag2 + 0.6 s (~6.8). Better, stagger all three 0.6 s apart in left-to-right order from tag1 (5.59 / 6.19 / 6.79), so no tag lands alone in silence. Keep the slot, size, warm-grey paper and order. Do not give any one tag a solo beat, a light change or a push. Re-sheet at 7.0, 10.26 and 14.5, and confirm all three are at full ink by 7.0.

ch15-s04: the METR ladder carries its own 'UNRELIABLE ABOVE HERE' warning, and the RCT that cuts the other way ('19% slower · felt 20% faster'), which the narration also says its authors now call out of date.
